info.title: Mission Control OS synthetic internal connection contract
info.description: Phase 2B opt-in synthetic IPv4-loopback HTTP binding around the Phase 2A gateway. Disabled by default. GET uses a required UTF-8 JSON envelope body; no query, cookie, browser CORS, forwarded identity or production authentication. Requires explicit synthetic-development startup and server-installed ephemeral bearer bindings. Domain policy and schema validation remain authoritative.

servers.description: Literal IPv4 loopback only; startup chooses an ephemeral port. No deployment or public endpoint.

get.description: Alias of GET /v1/visibility; requires visibility.project with audience command and team_reference null. Existing exact packet policy, tenant, correlation and revision checks remain authoritative. No invented stages, owners or metrics.

timestamp.description: Aware, within 60 seconds of trusted local clock.
Aware, within 60 seconds of trusted local clock.

GovernedCommandItem.description: Internal browser-only minimized service contract. Nullable means unavailable; no raw payload, policy or approval evidence.

GovernedCommandCenter.description: Internal browser-only projection. Exact six-stage order and authorized counts are additionally enforced in code; no operational/public endpoint is added.

SyntheticActionEligibility.description: Server-calculated, short-lived internal browser-only eligibility. It is neither organizational approval nor a mutation capability. Recomputed before dispatch and prerequisites repeated in the actual transaction.

SyntheticFixtureContext.description: Ephemeral synthetic token installed by trusted startup, mapped server-side to a LocalContext. Not production authentication. Actor, session, tenant and policy are independently verified by Phase 2A. Never log tokens.

x-http-boundary.host: exact bound literal IPv4 address and port
